_comment: Timelines tab knobs, read only by lib/timelineLayout.js. Content lives in backend/data/timelines; colours in theme.json's timeline group.
_comment-axis: width-rem is the line's column on a wide screen: thin, so the opened event gets the page. Room for year, Hijri year and title.
_comment-steps: The steps inside an opened event are open on arrival. A step can be folded only when it is worth skimming past: it holds moments, its summary runs to fold-from-chars or more, or the data marks it aside (a side detail away from the main story), which also starts it folded.
_comment-asbab: The side panel of asbab al-nuzul reports. Past search-from reports the list gets a search box; under it, a search box would be a control for a list you can already see all of.
_comment-map: px-per-degree turns lon/lat into drawing units; the view box is a section's lon/lat box times this. Views are twice as wide as tall so the map fills the reader's width; text and pins scale with the view's height, the side drawn at a fixed size. Places closer than merge-deg share one pin (Makkah, Hira, Arafat, al-Hudaybiyyah). A name goes right of its pin, or left when the right is taken; char-width guesses a letter's width as a share of the font size; label-gap is the space from pin centre to name, in pin radii. A name with no free side is left off; hovering shows it. max-rem caps how tall it is drawn, in rem so a short window does not letterbox it; min-rem keeps a phone map tall enough to read, trimming the empty east and west edges instead (views are centred on their pins). Drawing ratios: hit-pins is the invisible press ring and chosen-pins the chosen dot, both in pin radii (the chosen size is also the space a label keeps from other dots); pin-stroke and coast-stroke are line widths in pin radii; halo is the dark edge behind a name and baseline drops text onto its pin, both in font sizes; ascent and descent are how far a name reaches above and below its baseline, for the overlap check.
